description: Request a paid Advanced DV/OV certificate from a CSR (Certificate Manager 2.0). OV (NCP_PAID_OV_01) requires organizationNo. validationMethod D = one-time DNS TXT record, PD = persistent DNS TXT record (set once, reused for later validations). Use dryRun=true to preview. Public zone only. Works with main-account and Sub Account keys (Sub Account verified 2026-11-25; earlier the 2.0 API rejected Sub Account keys with HTTP 403).

dnsName.description: Domains for the certificate SAN (Subject Alternative Name)

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without requesting

validationMethod.description: DCV method: D (one-time DNS TXT) or PD (persistent DNS TXT)

name: ncloud_cm2_request_advanced_certificate
